scope: 2,048 frozen mixed edits per size. Construction memory is one Node GC capacity trace, including fixture/oracle/native metadata; not page/GPU memory. Browser actions repeat three times with contemporaneous whole-machine load. Open-plus-first-edit measures worker hydration and a real core brush, not a rendered editor frame.

policy.overflow: One oversized working patch allowed. Gesture journal, current/native metadata and cold index grow; only retained historical payload is bounded. In-session undo patches are kept on owned disk, not in the project beyond the last 100.

cases.capacityCodec: Construction trace used the conservative JSON/copy-pair patch representation before final binary/range compaction; same indexed capture, math and 64 MiB cache policy. Final reopening cache checked separately.
